summary: Preserved the valid Pointer/Tensor/Layout documentation and layout-coordinate regression from candidate PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/pull/559, then corrected the concrete omissions reproduced from independent review PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/pull/597 at candidate commit e88832e7d8079370e0a99d043e10d1bb92990200. Added docstrings for all 21 specifically reported public members and made all 38 changed Pointer/Tensor/layout examples self-contained, at most five lines, and executable from extracted docstrings. This is a bounded correction for the approved Pointer/Tensor/layout surface, not full package-wide closure of the upstream documentation issue.

No whitespace errors in the consolidated correction.

remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so the prepared native rebuild was not applicable.

The approved investigation boundary was the Pointer/Tensor/layout APIs implicated by the review. The original issue's much broader request to document every public symbol in flydsl/compiler and flydsl/utils remains outside this bounded correction; neither GPU availability nor missing weights was used to justify speculative changes there.

The runnable property examples intentionally define traced kernels without launching them because their values require real annotated Pointer/Tensor arguments. Existing real GPU tests separately validate those runtime contracts.
Only the available gfx950-class device was exercised; other architectures remain unverified.
